steps.say: The Temperature Controller is the heater board: a PID loop that heats to a setpoint. After Launch in Setup it appears in the sidebar under its name; press the name to open this page.
Current temperature is what the board reports, a little under twice a second. It reads N/A until the first reading, Disconnected when the link is down, and Simulated on a SIM port.
Setpoint is the temperature to hold, 0 to 300 °C (the station's limit). Typing a number heats nothing: only Enter settings sends it.
The rest of what Enter settings sends sits one level down. Press Configure Temperature Controller to open it.

Ramp rate, in seconds per degree as on the board's display (RR): when heating, the board raises its working setpoint 1 °C every that many seconds until it reaches the setpoint. A lower setpoint is taken at once.
P, I and D are the loop's gains; Offset (-100 to 100 °C) is added to the thermocouple reading. All of them go with every Enter settings, together with the setpoint and the ramp rate.
The plot shows the last couple of minutes of readings as they arrive.
Enter settings sends all six fields as one frame. If any field does not parse, nothing is sent: the board would read the fields shifted. Too many decimals are refused too; use fewer.
Heating to is the setpoint the board was last sent. It is empty while the heater is off, so a typed but unsent setpoint never looks like heating.
Heating has no idle timeout, and the board has no watchdog of its own: it holds the last setpoint for as long as it has power, until a stop reaches it. Stop it when you are done.
Stop heater turns the heater off now (setpoint and gains to 0) without latching anything. A stop always wins over an Enter settings still waiting to be sent.
On a real board, stopping while heating counts only once the board reports its setpoint at 0 within 1.5 s. If it does not, a warning says it may still be heating: switch it off at the controller.
The stop: the Stop disc on the rail, or Ctrl+. from anywhere on the page, sends the same heater-off to every device at once and latches it. Enter settings greys out until the stop is cleared.
When every device is stopped the disc reads Clear; pressing it asks, then clears. Clearing does not heat again: press Enter settings when you want heat. Ctrl+. only ever stops.
Open Diagnostics for the link and this device's own stop.
Connection is the link's state. After a few failed readings the station warns and keeps retrying; check the cable and power. If the board stays silent, use Hard reset on its row in Settings.
Stop this model sends the heater-off and latches only this device. Pressed again (it then reads Stopped) it clears just this one, after asking.
Keep the station in its own browser window while heating: if no browser checks in for 15 s while a device is energized, the station stops every device.
